detail: EN:'And split our share of the eggs with you? No way, José!' ZH:'然后和我们去分享这些蛋？做梦吧，约瑟！'
EN:'I squashed the Radroach, no problem.' ZH:'我踩扁了一只辐射蟑螂，小意思。'
EN:"Dwellers can't beat a team of former Overseers." ZH:'居民们怎么可能打得过由一群前监督者组成的队伍呢？'
EN:"Not if I can help it! Here, hold this. He's gonna have a conversation with my fist!" ZH:'说的我好像能控制得住！来，拿着这个。他先要和我的拳头讲讲理。'
EN:"The jumpsuits are kind of a giveaway, aren't they? Thanks for the advice." ZH:'这些连体衣就是暴露你们的破绽，对吧？谢谢你的建议。'
EN:"You won't be crashin' this wedding!" ZH:'你们休想破坏这个婚礼！'
EN:'An itsy bitsy teeny weeny ye... Never mind.' ZH:'一件很小很小的小小的……衣服。唉算了。'
EN:"Manage? So you're here for Mr. Manager. You will never take him away! He tells us stories!" ZH:'管理？所以你是来找经理大人的。你休想带走他！他给我们讲故事！'
EN:'Oh, how interesting. A crudely-written sign. “Enter and die!” No ambiguity there.' ZH:'哦，真有趣。一块潦草写就的标牌。“进来就死！”表意够明确了。'
EN:'The people of Filly are in dire need of medicine. There are rumours of a traveling chem-merchant wandering nea' ZH:'菲利镇的居民急需药品。有传言说附近有一位旅行药物商人。你应该很容易就能找到他。'
EN:"Ah, well you should have said so before. Can't be too careful, you know?" ZH:'啊，你以前就应该这么说。你知道，越小心越好。'
EN:'See ya never, losers.' ZH:'再见了，失败者。'
EN:"Wait, is this my free time or my work time? I can't keep track anymore." ZH:'等等，这是我的休息时间还是工作时间？我已经乱套了。'
EN:"Who's there? Wait. You know what? Never mind. I don't care." ZH:'谁在那儿？等等。算了，我才懒得问。'
EN:'A stuffed rabbit nailed to a door. Not really sure WHAT to make of that...' ZH:'一个兔子玩偶钉在门上，这该怎么理解呢？'
EN:"It's not much... but it's home." ZH:'虽然简陋……但这里是家。'
EN:"♪ Doo-wop-wop, that's our song ♪\n♪ Don't you dare to sing along! ♪" ZH:'♪ 嘟哇哇，那是我们的歌 ♪\n♪ 你敢跟着一起唱！♪'
EN:'This room lights up my life. No, really! It does!' ZH:'这个房间点亮了我的生命。真的！是字面意思！'
EN:'No Time for Paws' ZH:'肉爪去哪儿了'
EN:'Woah! You took that thing out like it was nothing!' ZH:'哇！你把那东西干掉了，太厉害了！'
EN:"You'll let him know that, won't you?" ZH:'你会告诉他的，对吧？'
EN:"Oh my. Isn't this... cheery." ZH:'哦，天哪。这儿可真是……“喜气洋洋”啊。'
EN:"Did you see Spot run? Not there you didn't. Lose Your Head!" ZH:'你有见过斑点跑来跑去吗？那里怎么会有它。“掉脑袋”吧！'
EN:"Oh look, a broken crib. Isn't that encouraging." ZH:'看哪，一个破损的婴儿床。真是“鼓舞人心”啊。'
EN:'You are from a Vault, no? May yours grow to be as amazing as ours.' ZH:'你们也是来自一个避难所，对吧？希望你们的避难所也能发展成我们这个样子。'
EN:'Pfft! Please. Rescuing? This is nothing but Raiders raiding. And it ends here!' ZH:'呸！拜托。拯救？你们这就是掠夺者赤裸裸的抢劫，一切到此为止！'
EN:'Nothing half as cool as this!' ZH:'比起我们这个差远了吧。'
EN:'Look, someone is finally here to help us! Not a moment too soon...' ZH:'瞧，终于有人来帮我们了！来得正是时候……'
EN:"You won't get away with this!" ZH:'你休想逃脱！'
EN:"Meet the Human Cannonball. And I'm gonna blast right through you if you don't get out of my way!" ZH:'让你们见识下“人间大炮”的威力。拦我路者，一律炸飞。'
EN:'First the Deathclaw, now Dwellers? This is not my day.' ZH:'先是死爪，然后是居民？这是什么鬼日子！'
EN:'Yeeeeaaah. Not gonna happen.' ZH:'呃……想得美。'
EN:'In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As p' ZH:'我们遇到了来自144号避难所、熟悉“死亡”的居民……她会把她知道的一切告诉我们！'
EN:"Now *that's* how you fight the Good Fight! I can't thank you heroes enough!" ZH:'现在*这就是*你打好仗的窍门！我非常感谢你们这些英雄！'
EN:"Not a day goes by that I don't revel in the servitude of humankind.\xa0" ZH:'每天我都沉浸在为人类服务的喜悦中。'
EN:'No Stone Unturned' ZH:'全力以赴'
EN:"Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, researching the mating habits of Radscorpions. Make sure he's not" ZH:'著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究辐射蝎的交配习惯，请确保他的安全。'
EN:'Cabin Without The Woods' ZH:'神秘小屋'
EN:"Oh look, a broken crib. Isn't that encouraging." ZH:'看哪，一个破损的婴儿床。真是“鼓舞人心”啊。'
EN:'This Vault is full of nothing but ghosts!' ZH:'这个避难所里只剩下鬼了！'
EN:'Looks like these no good Radroaches stole that food! This ought to get that Raider off the hook!' ZH:'看起来像是辐射蟑螂偷了他们的食物！这应该能还那个掠夺者清白了。'
EN:"Should I go that way? Hmmm. No, I'll go this way." ZH:'我应该走那条路吗？嗯……算了，我还是走这条吧。'
EN:'Oh, how interesting. A crudely-written sign. “Enter and die!” No ambiguity there.' ZH:'哦，真有趣。一块潦草写就的标牌。“进来就死！”表意够明确了。'
EN:'Oh no! My poor babies! So missunderstood. Go. Go. Leave me to my grief, you monster!' ZH:'天哪！我可怜的宝贝们！总是被误解。走！走！让我一个人哀悼吧，你这个怪物！'
EN:'Ooo! Not even close. Guess you... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'哦！差得远呢。我想你要……“掉脑袋”！'
EN:'Seemed like a no-brainer. So, um, I guess now we all fight?' ZH:'这看来是明摆着的事。所以，呃，我们开打吧？'
EN:'This Vault is devoted to nothing but Lady Luck herself!' ZH:'这个避难所都是为幸运女神而存在的！'
EN:"A Giant Radscorpion? As if the normal ones aren't bad enough! This might be the end!" ZH:'一只巨型辐射蝎？普通的就已经够可怕了！我这回可能要完蛋了！'
EN:'JOIN ME! UNLESS YOU WANT A... ME... ON YOUR HANDS.' ZH:'加入我！除非你想有一个……我……在你手上。'
EN:"Aren't you a little far from home, Vaultie?" ZH:'避难所来的小家伙，离家挺远吧？'
EN:"Rusty? Full of holes? I don't know!" ZH:'生锈之城？千疮百孔的城市？我怎么会知道？！'
EN:"Not a day goes by that I don't revel in the servitude of humankind.\xa0" ZH:'每天我都沉浸在为人类服务的喜悦中。'
EN:"Oh my. Isn't this... cheery." ZH:'哦，天哪。这儿可真是……“喜气洋洋”啊。'
EN:'That would be a silly name. Off with your... no... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'那真是个愚蠢的名字。好吧，准备……“掉脑袋”吧！'
EN:'Wait, maybe we can do this without any more fighting.' ZH:'等等，也许我们能和平解决这个问题。'
EN:'You said it. Those pants do you no favors.' ZH:'你说的对呀，这些裤子丑爆了。'
EN:"Oh, a corpse! Isn't that pleasant." ZH:'哦，一具尸体！可真“令人愉快”啊。'
EN:"I loved him once, you know. But he's nothing but a cheating jerk!" ZH:'你知道吗，我曾经爱过他。可他就是个彻头彻尾的骗子！'
EN:"Our team name is... The Only Ones Who Aren't Idiots." ZH:'我们的队名是……“除了我们都是白痴”。'
EN:"You're lucky I didn't shoot you just then..." ZH:'你真幸运，我刚才差点开枪了……'
EN:"Aren't you a little short for a vault dweller? Whatever, I'm done with bedtime stories." ZH:'和一个避难所居民比起来你也太矮了吧？算了，我受够睡前故事了。'
EN:'Too bad you will fail, and your Vault will be ours!' ZH:'可惜你会失败，你的避难所将是我们的！'
EN:'You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from insi' ZH:'你在返回菲利镇的路上经过一个破旧的加油站，听到里面传来的奇怪声音。那会是什么呢？只有进去才能知道！'
EN:"One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality..." ZH:'你的一位居民一直称自己是“会痛的火车”。我们来让他梦想成真……'
EN:'All Killy No Filly' ZH:'菲利之殇'
EN:"There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, " ZH:'有一个新的掠夺者帮派，欧拉的天使，在废土为非作歹！闲话少说，我们得派最聪明的居民去化解这些激进分子的威胁，解决当前的危急局面。'
EN:"You're undercover for the Weekly Exposition, aren't you?" ZH:'你是每周博览会的卧底，对吧？'
EN:'No offense, but this is a dangerous place to be gardening.' ZH:'恕我冒犯，但在这地方搞园艺有点危险啊。'
EN:'A stuffed rabbit nailed to a door. Not really sure WHAT to make of that...' ZH:'一个兔子玩偶钉在门上，这该怎么理解呢？'
EN:'No! You lose, you loser. On top of that, you get to... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'错！你输了，你这个输家。而且，你还要……“掉脑袋”了！'
EN:"Yeeeeaahhh... See, I'm more of a “lover not a fighter” type." ZH:'是……是啊……你看，比起当战士，我更适合当爱人。'
EN:'Three words: Never. Ending. Deathclaws.' ZH:'三个词：永远。结束。死爪。'
EN:'Not unless they sell farmers as meat. Time to... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'除非他们像卖肉一样卖农民。是时候……“掉脑袋”了！'
EN:"Don't you mean “quench your thirst”?" ZH:'你是说“解渴”吗？'
EN:"You ain't getting nothing from me!" ZH:'休想从我这得到什么！'
EN:"Name's Bigsby. Nicky sent ya, didn't he? Much as I'd love to get to know ya, we've got a more pressing matter." ZH:'我是比格斯比。是尼克派你们来的对吧？虽然我很想和你们好好聊聊，我们现在有更重要的问题要解决。'
EN:"Call the doctor! I'm having an infarction! That's a heart attack. Because you're so... Oh, never mind." ZH:'快叫医生！我心肌梗塞了！就是心脏病发作那种。因为你实在太……哦，算了。'
EN:'Not before we get what we came for.' ZH:'除非我们得到我们想要的。'

EN:'Dwellers in the room automatically fight the Disaster.
Dwellers lose health while fighting a Disaster.
If Dwel' ZH:'房间里的居民会自动和灾害斗争。
居民在和灾害斗争的时候会损失生命值。
如果居民失败了，灾害会蔓延到邻近的房间。'
EN:'Not if we stop you and your unbearable expressions right now.' ZH:'除非我们现在就阻止你和你那令人难以忍受的言论。'
EN:"It isn't much, but it's what we've got! Please enjoy your stay." ZH:'虽然简陋，但这就是我们的一切！请尽情享受在这里的时光。'
EN:"Hey, look! That's gold there, isn't it?" ZH:'嘿，看！那里是金子，对吧？'
EN:'To be or not to be, that is my question…' ZH:'生存还是毁灭，这是我的问题……'
EN:'Fairies? Fairies grant wishes, no? I wish for gold.' ZH:'精灵？精灵能满足愿望，对吧？我许愿要黄金。'
EN:"We can't get any good help these days." ZH:'如今想找点得力帮手可真难。'
EN:"You're *them*, aren't you? I knew this day would come." ZH:'你们是*他们*，对吧？我就知道会有这一天。'
EN:'Looks like we came for nothing then. Our goal was to stop those experiments.' ZH:'看来我们是白跑一趟了。我们的目标是阻止那些实验。'
EN:'There we go. No problemo.' ZH:'搞定。小意思。'
EN:'No way this can go wrong, right?' ZH:'这怎么可能出错，对吧？'
EN:"None of my beeswax! Come to Mr. House's party!" ZH:'关我屁事！快来参加豪斯先生的派对吧！'
EN:"Unless it's a Ghoul party. Then, it's the perfect atmosphere!" ZH:'除非这是尸鬼派对。那就完美了！'
EN:"We don't care either way. A job's a job. See you there!" ZH:'我们怎么都行。活就是活。到时见！'
EN:"Ah! It's you! Poetic, isn't it? You and Wyatt, erased on the same day." ZH:'啊！是你！多讽刺，对吧？你和怀亚特，同一天被抹去。'
EN:'There are no Synths, fool. This is a trap!' ZH:'哪有什么合成人，蠢货。这是个陷阱！'
EN:"You're not gonna kick mine!" ZH:'你休想踢我的屁股！'
EN:"Real mercenary, aren't you? I suppose I should say thanks…" ZH:'可真够雇佣兵的。我想我该说声谢谢……'
EN:"I can't shake the feeling that this is all staged for us." ZH:'我总觉得这一切都是为我们布置的。'
EN:'Especially when mixed with chems... no wonder they got kicked out.' ZH:'尤其混着药物……难怪他们被赶出来了。'
EN:"Is that a wild Deathclaw? Or part of the hivemind? No matter: it's charging!" ZH:'那是只野生死爪？还是集体意识的一部分？管他呢：它冲过来了！'
EN:'Only after we are out, right? RIGHT? Here goes nothing...' ZH:'得在我们离开之后，对吧？对吧？豁出去了……'
EN:'Well, I never… ' ZH:'哼，真是岂有此理……'
EN:"I'm obviously not talking to the right people. Move along." ZH:'很显然，我找错人了。走开。'
EN:'You are on your own. We just came here to watch you fail.' ZH:'你们自求多福吧。我们只是来看你们怎么惨败的。'
